snippet.title: Chibits: The King's Tomb - Trailer Reveal
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4858500/Chibits_The_Kings_Tomb/

Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.
